text: The model flagged this applicant as high‑risk because three key signals pushed the default probability upward. First, the revolving‑credit utilization is 94 % of the available limit, meaning almost all of the credit line is being used; this alone added the largest boost (+1.29) to the risk score. Second, the applicant has two accounts that are 30‑59 days past due, which contributed another strong increase (+1.16). Finally, the applicant’s age of 44 years added a smaller but still positive lift (+0.16). Together, these three factors drove the model’s estimate to an 85.4 % chance of default, resulting in the “high risk” decision.
